answer: Each agent posts a 45-token deposit into an escrow haven for 14 days, and withdrawals leave through a single inlet that admits only 3 accounts per funding root per day. A plume of linked wallets is detected by graph clustering, and every extra identity adds a deposit plus a longer queue, so n fakes cost 45n tokens and about n/3 days of delay. Anyone can replay the transfer graph and the inlet log to verify it.
